purpose: Research-backed engine selection, not a runtime installed-engine manifest.

policy.required: Engine code/environment/entrypoints must be built and integrated before pre-GPU acceptance; weights may await runtime and explicit terms, status remains accurate.
policy.alternative: Adopt only with a measured or specified distinct advantage and the same integration gates. Not silently obligatory.
policy.conditional: No public bundling or supported claim until named availability/license/hardware gate is resolved; preserve the mandatory capability with its actual primary route.
policy.excluded: No automatic installation, copying or inference. Primary permitted route replaces this option.
policy.reference_only: Not an implementable dependency at evidence snapshot.

universal_fields_to_resolve_in_repo: code/model/data license scopes and image redistribution decision
GPU architecture and extension ABI matrix
build recipe and measured installed bytes
health states and actual execute/cancel/unload protocol
